## Further reading {#sec-additional-resources}

- @marsden2013vector
  is a standard textbook on multivariable and vector calculus.
  It covers differentiation of functions of several variables, multiple integrals,
  line and surface integrals, and the theorems of Green, Gauss, and Stokes.

See also the [Linear Algebra and Vector Calculus
further reading](linear-algebra.qmd#sec-additional-resources).

- [Hua Zhou](https://hua-zhou.github.io/)'s [lecture notes for "UCLA Biostat 216 - Mathematical Methods for Biostatistics" (2023 Fall)](https://ucla-biostat-216.github.io/2023fall/schedule/schedule.html)
